calculation.description: Reverses each tradable asset's market-residual daily return, with a modest amplification when the five-day log US10Y/CN10Y spread shock is unusually large. All inputs are lagged completed-day observations; US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark series used as macro regime inputs.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.060465, 592 dates), 2023-2024 (0.057006, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.027525, 491 dates). The factor passes the benchmark gates of absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840. Uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is 15 instruments.
